ops.issue: 'Quanto a...' topic device used although the sentence has no は topic (structure is 公務員に + なりたい); it also recasts the verb phrase as a topicalized infinitive clause. lit_en has no 'As for'.

before.jp: 公務員になりたい
before.kana: こうむいんになりたい

structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the structure [noun に なる] ('to become something') combined with the desiderative 〜たい ('to want to do'). 公務員 is the endpoint marked by the particle に; なる ('to become') has its stem なり + たい forming なりたい ('I want to become'). It's a casual sentence, without です at the end.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase usa a estrutura [substantivo に なる] ('tornar-se algo') combinada com o desiderativo 〜たい ('querer fazer'). 公務員 é o ponto de chegada marcado pela partícula に; なる ('tornar-se') tem sua raiz なり + たい formando なりたい ('quero me tornar'). É uma frase casual, sem です no final.
